settings.visualStyle: Second Battle of El Alamein 1942 historical reenactment, embedded desert field-camera look, pale sand, harsh sun, dust haze, smoke, historically plausible British Eighth Army uniforms and equipment, tanks and gun positions, muted 35mm wartime color, non-graphic combat.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. Follow one fictional British desert infantryman through waiting, armor reveal, advance, incoming fire, support positions, a brief canteen pause and continued movement. No dialogue or narrator. One primary action and one camera movement per scene.
settings.customVisualStyle: Dry tactile desert film: heat shimmer, wind-driven dust, sun-bleached uniforms, sand in equipment seams, distant armor silhouettes and layered artillery sound.

movie.plotDetails: Fictional composite British infantryman is used only as a continuity anchor within a historically plausible El Alamein battlefield.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create an immersive two-minute historical reenactment of the Second Battle of El Alamein in 1942. Follow one fictional British infantryman from a tense desert waiting position through armor-supported movement, shelling, low gun pits, dusty open ground, a short hydration pause and another push toward the horizon. No narration or dialogue. Keep action grounded and non-graphic, with dust and heat as constant physical elements.
movie.storySummary: A British infantryman waits in a low desert position as armor forms beyond the ridge. The unit advances, drops under incoming fire, moves between gun pits and open sand, then pauses briefly to drink and gather itself. Supporting armor and artillery keep the line moving. The episode ends at sunset with troops and vehicles still crossing a vast dusty battlefield.
movie.storyTitle: WWII FRONTLINE FOOTAGE EP05 — El Alamein 1942: War in the Desert

scenes.title: Heat Before the Move
scenes.description: Infantry waits low in the desert under hard morning light and drifting dust.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier crouches with his section, checking the horizon while wind pushes sand across boots.
scenes.imageDescription: El Alamein 1942, low desert cover, British infantry in sandy field uniforms, canteens and rifles, heat haze, dust, pale hard light, period equipment.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow side drift at crouch height. Audio: wind, sand, gear, distant artillery, no speech.

scenes.title: Armor Through the Dust
scenes.description: Tank silhouettes appear beyond a low sandy ridge.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman rises slightly and watches armor forming through dust.
scenes.imageDescription: Low desert ridge, tank silhouettes through dusty haze, infantry foreground, no glamour, realistic 1942 battlefield scale.
scenes.videoPrompt: Pan across the ridge following armor silhouettes. Audio: distant engines, wind, low artillery rumble.

scenes.title: Advance Begins
scenes.description: The infantry line starts moving behind supporting armor.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier advances at a crouched walk with tanks farther ahead.
scenes.imageDescription: Open desert, British infantry moving in spaced line, tanks and smoke background, same soldier with light dust on uniform.
scenes.videoPrompt: Forward handheld follow shot behind the moving section. Audio: boots in sand, engines, gear, wind.

scenes.title: Incoming Sand
scenes.description: Shells land nearby and send columns of dust into the air.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier drops flat beside a shallow depression while dust falls over him.
scenes.imageDescription: Open desert under shelling, non-graphic dust plumes, infantry flattening low, tanks distant.
scenes.videoPrompt: One impact-driven shake and drop to ground level. Audio: blast, sand debris, muffled recovery, breath.

scenes.title: Gun Pit Cover
scenes.description: The section reaches a low prepared gun position and takes temporary cover.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier slides behind sandbags as a nearby support crew works its weapon.
scenes.imageDescription: Desert gun pit, sandbags, ammunition crates, British support crew, same soldier dusty and crouched, non-graphic action.
scenes.videoPrompt: Handheld move into the gun pit, ending low behind sandbags. Audio: weapon mechanism, distant shelling, sand, breath.

scenes.title: Support Fire
scenes.description: The support position opens fire toward the opposing line.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier reloads his rifle while a support weapon fires beside him.
scenes.imageDescription: Low gun position, ammunition crates, firing support weapon, dusty infantryman reloading, historically plausible gear.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium embedded-camera shot with one pan from rifleman to support weapon. Audio: support gun bursts, casing sounds, wind. No speech.

scenes.title: Through the Dust Curtain
scenes.description: A wind gust and battlefield smoke reduce visibility across the advance route.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier follows the silhouette of the man ahead through blowing dust.
scenes.imageDescription: Dense desert dust, infantry silhouettes, visibility short, same soldier with scarf or collar against sand, period gear.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow forward handheld push through the dust curtain. Audio: wind stronger, boots, gear, distant engines muted.

scenes.title: Ridge Crossing
scenes.description: The unit crests a low ridge and briefly becomes exposed against the sky.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier runs the last steps to the crest and drops beyond it.
scenes.imageDescription: Silhouetted infantry crossing sandy ridge, pale sky, dust and distant armor, no close enemy.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low-angle crest shot following one short run over the ridge. Audio: heavy breathing, boots, wind, distant gunfire.

scenes.title: Tank Pass
scenes.description: A supporting tank rumbles close past the infantry position.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier pauses low as a tank passes and throws dust across the frame.
scenes.imageDescription: Historically plausible British tank passing infantry, churned sand, dust cloud, rifleman shielding his face slightly.
scenes.videoPrompt: Side tracking pan with the tank, ending as dust washes over camera. Audio: tracks, engine, sand, gear.

scenes.title: Canteen Pause
scenes.description: Inside shallow cover the soldier takes a brief drink during a lull.
scenes.actionDescription: He unscrews his canteen, drinks quickly and wipes dust from his mouth.
scenes.imageDescription: Dusty infantryman seated low behind sandbags, canteen in hand, rifle resting beside him, sunlight hard and dry.
scenes.videoPrompt: Quiet close shot on canteen and face. Audio: metal cap, swallowing, wind, distant artillery with long gaps.

scenes.title: Back Into the Advance
scenes.description: The lull ends and the section rises from cover.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier shoulders his rifle and moves forward with the line.
scenes.imageDescription: Infantry rising from low cover, dust hanging in air, distant smoke and armor ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear follow shot as the line stands and moves. Audio: gear, boots, distant engines and guns.

scenes.title: Anti-Tank Position
scenes.description: The section passes a threatened anti-tank gun position under pressure.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier moves past the crew while they work rapidly around the gun.
scenes.imageDescription: Desert anti-tank position, sandbags, gun crew working, infantry crossing behind, smoke and heat shimmer.
scenes.videoPrompt: Handheld lateral shot moving past the gun team. Audio: metal handling, distant armor, artillery, no speech.

scenes.title: Golden Dust
scenes.description: Late-afternoon light turns suspended dust into a hazy gold curtain.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier pauses on the ridge and scans the battlefield below.
scenes.imageDescription: Golden desert haze, smoke columns, scattered vehicles and infantry, soldier foreground small against scale.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow panoramic sweep from soldier to battlefield. Audio: wind, distant engines, intermittent guns.

scenes.title: Ground Taken Slowly
scenes.description: The unit walks through freshly fought-over sand without celebration.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman walks past churned tracks, empty crates and drifting smoke.
scenes.imageDescription: After-fight desert terrain, vehicle tracks, abandoned crates, tired infantry, no graphic casualties.
scenes.videoPrompt: Walking aftermath shot at shoulder height. Audio: boots, wind, distant artillery, gear.

scenes.title: War in the Desert
scenes.description: The battlefield stretches beyond the day’s advance as sun falls toward the horizon.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier continues with the column while tanks and infantry become silhouettes in dust.
scenes.imageDescription: Wide vertical desert sunset, tanks and infantry silhouettes, smoke and dust, same soldier receding with unit, no victory pose.
scenes.videoPrompt: Long rear closing shot with slight field-camera drift. Audio: fading engines, boots, wind, restrained score tail.

characters.name: Desert Infantryman

continuity.continuityRules: Same face, uniform, rifle and web gear throughout. Dust accumulation increases steadily and remains after the canteen scene.
